اختبئن (form VIII)
# اُخْتُبِئْنَ (uḵtubiʔna) /ux.tu.biʔ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
# اِخْتَبِئْنَ (iḵtabiʔna) /ix.ta.biʔ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِخْتَبَأَ (iḵtabaʔa)
